_comment: Reviewed corrections to the machine-translated pass, applied by tools/assemble.mjs
after the chunks are merged so they survive a regeneration.
Two rules decide what belongs here:
1. Where the shipped Chinese dictionary localizes a value, the Korean pack does too.
2. Where it keeps the English value (product names, protocol names, wire values,
command names, units, placeholders), the Korean pack keeps it as well.
tools/audit-untranslated.mjs lists every candidate; everything not listed here is
